h:
ComfyUI 工作流程，用于生成两个清晰分离的主题，并具有区域提示控制。该工作流程对全局图像、主题 1、主题 2、交互、解剖、场景和照明使用单独的积极提示部分。它还支持全局和基于蒙版的区域负面提示，允许针对特定主题进行更正，例如防止性别互换、重复头部、错误的年龄外观、合并的四肢和不需要的身体部位混合。

人/主题始终位于白色一侧，具体取决于您下载或由人工智能创建的黑白图像以及使用它的位置，您必须始终将白色侧描述为全局以及相应人/主题积极提示中图像中的位置。

o.en:
A ComfyUI workflow for generating two clearly separated subjects with regional prompt control. The workflow uses separate positive prompt sections for the global image, subject 1, subject 2, interaction, anatomy, scene, and lighting. It also supports global and mask-based regional negative prompts, allowing subject-specific corrections such as preventing gender swaps, duplicate heads, wrong age appearance, merged limbs, and unwanted body-part mixing.

The person/subject is always on the white side, depending on which black and white image you download or have created by an AI, and where you use it, you must always describe the white side as a position in the image in the global as well as in the respective person/subject positive prompt.
